items.title: Mount Seorak offers captivating view of late-autumn foliage

items.summary: The brightest flames, they say, burn just before going out. The autumn leaves blanketing the mountains in red seemed to be burning with equal intensity, as if sensing the end of their season. By mid-November, the foliage in Naeseorak, the western side of Daecheongbong Peak, had largely faded and fallen, but Oeseorak was still displaying its final burst of color. Even beneath thick fog that limited visibility, the mountains' beauty was impossible to conceal. Peaks emerged through the mist, overlooking forests ablaze with autumn hues. In late fall, Mount Seorak remains beautiful enough to delight even visitors who arrive a little late for the foliage season. Word of its spectacular scenery has crossed oceans. Mount Seorak's autumn foliage is now as well-known overseas as it is in Korea. Foreign tourists have long been discovering the country's mountains, and their travels have expanded beyond Seoul and Jeju Island to the mountainous regions of Gangwon Province. items.title: Embrace AI, but invest in detection for high-stakes exams, global experts say amid cheating fears
items.title_zh: 全球专家表示，在担心作弊的同时，应拥抱人工智能，但要对高风险考试的检测投入资金
items.summary: Global higher education experts are urging universities to embrace artificial intelligence (AI) as a catalyst for change rather than a threat, calling for a fundamental rethink of how students are assessed. But for high-stakes exams such as Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), where traditional testing methods are difficult to replace, they stress the need for greater investment in technology to detect AI-assisted cheating. Korea has been gripped by growing fears of AI-assisted cheating, as concerns over the misuse of smart glasses and other wearable devices spread beyond the CSAT to university admissions, campus exams and professional licensing tests. Kuancheng Huang, a professor at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University in Taiwan, called for greater investment in technology to detect AI-assisted cheating, particularly in high-stakes exams. Huang visited Seoul to attend the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University. items.title: Seoul City Hall observatory extends evening hours, opens Sundays
items.title_zh: 首尔市政厅观景台延长夜间开放时间，周日开放
items.summary: Visitors to Korea’s capital now have more time to take in its glittering winter skyline, as city extends evening hours at Seoul City Hall Sky Observatory downtown and opens the panoramic viewing deck on Sundays for the first time this season. The expanded schedule will run from Dec. 11, 2026, through Feb. 9, 2027, coinciding with the Seoul Winter Festa and the operation of the Seoul Plaza ice rink, the Seoul Metropolitan Government said. The observatory, located on the eighth and ninth floors of Seoul City Hall’s main building, will remain open until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday, and until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday. Special hours will allow visitors to stay until midnight on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, while the observatory will close at 10 p.m. on Christmas Day. The observatory will operate from 7:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday, from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Sunday. items.title: Sungkyunkwan University partners with UK's NPL on quantum technology research
items.title_zh: 成均馆大学与英国国家物理实验室（NPL）合作开展量子技术研究
items.summary: Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU) has signed a memorandum of understanding with the National Physical Laboratory (NPL), the U.K.’s national metrology institute, to expand joint research and technological cooperation in quantum science and technology. The university said the agreement was signed on Nov. 4 and aims to combine its research expertise and infrastructure in quantum engineering with the NPL’s capabilities in precision measurement. The two institutions will collaborate on the development of next-generation quantum devices and novel materials, the fabrication of superconducting quantum computing hardware and advanced precision measurement and characterization. Quantum technologies harness the principles of quantum physics to enable applications such as quantum computing, highly sensitive measurement and secure communications. The NPL plays a key role in developing measurement techniques and standards to ensure the reliable performance and practical application of these technologies. items.title: Korea's research rising, but universities must break down silos: WUN chief
items.title_zh: WUN负责人：韩国的研究水平正在提升，但大学必须打破信息孤岛
items.summary: Universities must work more closely with industry, business and government to turn research into real-world impact, and Korean universities are well placed to do so as the country’s research standing rises, according to the head of a global university alliance. Dawn Freshwater, executive director of the Worldwide Universities Network (WUN), made the remarks in an interview with The Korea Times Thursday, during the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University in Seoul. WUN is a consortium of research-intensive universities across six continents that funds and supports international research collaboration among its members. Freshwater said universities have long been cut off from government, industry and business. items.title: Employment rate for child-rearing moms hits highest ever: data
items.title_zh: 育儿期妈妈的就业率创历史新高：数据
items.summary: The employment rate for mothers with minors reached an all-time high during the six-month period ending in April on the back of policy backups, data showed Thursday. The employment rate for mothers with children aged under 18 reached 66.2 percent in the November 2025-April 2026 period, up 1.9 percentage points from a year earlier, according to the data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The reading marks the highest since related data began to be compiled in 2016. Shortened working hours for such moms and other policies friendly for them helped jack up their employment, the ministry said. Against these backdrops, the rate of married women with children taking breaks from their careers dropped 2 percentage points to 19.3 percent, also the lowest ever.

items.title: Korea, US, 11 other countries issue statement on cooperation against online scams

items.summary: Korea, the United States and 11 other countries released a joint statement Thursday on their cooperation in combating online scams through information sharing, proactive law enforcement and other measures, according to Seoul's foreign ministry. The countries issued a "statement of principles," decrying online scams as "serious and complex" transnational crimes that threaten regional and international peace and security. They included Australia, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, Britain, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. The statement came as Seoul has been striving to address online scams targeting its citizens, following reports of Koreans being abducted and held in Cambodia by criminal rings in recent years. The countries stressed their commitment to considering "targeted" economic sanctions and other measures, including denial of entry, to disrupt criminal activities stemming from online scams and related transnational organizations, according to the statement. items.title: What Korea can learn from California's 10-flagship university system

items.summary: Collaboration, rather than competition, backed by strong leadership and shared governance, has been key to building a University of California (UC) system in which all 10 campuses thrive by developing their own strengths. Darren Cooke, chief innovation and entrepreneurship officer at UC Berkeley, emphasized the importance of strong leadership and a shared governing structure in bringing universities together while allowing each to build on its own strengths. "Every one is amazing, right, and has its own strengths, and I think that's the key. Every one has its own strengths," Cooke said during an interview with The Korea Times. The UC system offers lessons for Korea as the government seeks to strengthen regional flagship national universities and develop them into institutions capable of competing with Seoul National University. The UC system brings together 10 campuses, including Berkeley, UCLA and UC San Diego, under a single governing structure while allowing each to develop its own academic and research strengths. items.title: [COVER STORY] Students take Korea's biggest college exam amid AI cheating fears
items.title_zh: [封面故事] 学生们在对人工智能作弊的担忧中参加韩国最大的大学入学考试
items.summary: Shin Ha-seong, a high school senior taking Thursday’s college entrance exam, was worried about a problem he had never seen coming: his horn-rimmed glasses. This year, proctors are checking whether test-takers are wearing smart glasses during every session amid growing concern over cheating with artificial intelligence (AI) technology. “I’m anxious I might be wrongly suspected, but there’s nothing I can do. I heard some people are switching from horn-rimmed to metal frames (so they won’t be mistaken for smart glasses),” Shin said, adding that his own pair is perfectly ordinary. Shin’s worries highlight the unease among students and parents as the prospect of AI-enabled cheating rocked Korea this week ahead of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT). The anxiety emerged after the top scorer on a national tax accountant licensing exam admitted Sunday to using a miniature camera and generative AI to cheat. items.title: Health minister embarks on Italian visit to strengthen health partnerships

items.summary: ROME — Saudi Minister of Health Fahad Al-Jalajel began on Wednesday an official visit to Italy to strengthen bilateral relations, expand health cooperation, and explore opportunities to establish strategic partnerships between the two countries.During the two-day visit, the minister is scheduled to hold high-level meetings with Italian health sector officials and leaders to discuss cooperation in advanced and specialized healthcare, health investment, digital health, biotechnology, and health workforce development.Al-Jalajel will also visit several healthcare and research institutions to learn about Italian practices and exchange expertise in developing health services. The visit comes within the framework of the strong relations between Saudi Arabia and Italy and reflects both countries’ commitment to strengthening partnerships, concluding agreements, and exchanging knowledge to advance their health sectors and create opportunities for investment and innovation.

Mayor of Riyadh Prince Faisal bin Abdulaziz bin Ayyaf and several officials attended the inaugural ceremony held at Qasr Al-Hukm in Riyadh on Wednesday. The Emir watched a presentation on the mayoralty’s efforts to expand green spaces, improve the urban landscape, and enhance quality of life. The mayoralty has opened 144 parks since 2021.Prince Faisal praised the Saudi leadership’s support for urban development. He stressed the importance of continuing to develop parks and public facilities to meet residents’ needs and keep pace with the region’s growth, in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

items.title: Coalition intercepts 2 Houthi drones fired at Riyadh and southern regions
items.title_zh: 联军拦截了2架针对利雅得和南部地区的胡塞武装无人机
items.summary: RIYADH — Two drones, fired by the terrorist Houthi militia, were intercepted and destroyed in the Riyadh and southern regions, according to Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen.

items.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli incursions into Syria
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯谴责以色列入侵叙利亚
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia's condemnation and denunciation of the Israeli occupation authorities' continued blatant violations in the region, most recently the Israeli incursions into the rural areas of Syria's Quneitra and Daraa governorates."Saudi Arabia expresses its categorical rejection of the Israeli occupation forces' intimidation of peace-loving civilians and violations of international laws and norms,” the ministry said in a statement. The ministry stressed the importance of halting Israeli infringements on the sovereignty of Syrian territory and adhering to the 1974 Disengagement Agreement to preserve security and stability in the region. The Kingdom also reiterated its support for Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

items.title: PIF named world’s most valuable sovereign wealth fund brand for third year in a row
items.title_zh: PIF连续第三年被评为全球最有价值的主权财富基金品牌
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) ranked as the world’s most valuable sovereign wealth fund brand for the third consecutive year, according to Brand Finance. The ranking reflects PIF’s efforts to build confidence in its global brand, whose value rose from $1.183 billion in 2025 to $1.2 billion in 2026, while its rating improved from A+ to AA-. The brand is the most valuable among sovereign wealth funds and global investment institutions outside the United States and Europe, and the only sovereign wealth fund brand valued above $1 billion. PIF also ranks in the top tier of global investment institutions and sovereign wealth funds, as the only sovereign fund in this category, based on the ratio of its brand value to its investment assets, a metric that reflects investment performance. Investor recommendations for partnerships with PIF reached twice the sector average from 2024 to 2026. According to Brand Finance, the fund’s achievements reflect a decade-long transformation that has positioned it among the world’s most influential investors. Its global brand leadership is expected to strengthen further during the value-creation phase of its 2026-2030 strategy, which focuses on active investment, attracting private capital, generating returns, and ensuring institutional excellence and robust governance. International ratings reflect the global standing of sovereign wealth funds and major financial institutions and bolster their presence in international markets. Beyond assessing financial and institutional performance, they serve as a strategic pillar for building institutional confidence amid global economic fluctuations. PIF is a key driver of sustainable economic transformation in the Kingdom and a major contributor to achieving Saudi Vision 2030. Alongside its efforts to develop strategic sectors and diversify and grow the local economy, its international rankings further reinforce its global standing and expand its presence in international markets. The new ranking follows the announcement of PIF’s 2026-2030 strategy, which builds on its long-term vision by developing highly competitive local economic ecosystems, strengthening integration across sectors, maximizing the value of strategic assets, advancing the Kingdom’s economic transformation, and improving quality of life for citizens. Under the strategy, PIF allocates its investments across three portfolios. The Vision Portfolio fosters integration across priority strategic sectors within six economic ecosystems: tourism, travel, and entertainment; urban development and livability; industrials and logistics; advanced manufacturing and innovation; clean energy, water, and renewables; and NEOM. The Strategic Portfolio focuses on managing key assets and maximizing their returns, enhancing the economic impact of portfolio companies, helping them attract domestic and international investment, and supporting their transformation into leading global enterprises. The Financial Portfolio seeks to generate sustainable returns to reinforce the fund’s position and grow national wealth for future generations. The fund’s third consecutive year at the top of global rankings marks a Saudi achievement, reflecting its strong brand and international standing. This milestone supports the fund’s goals under its 2026-2030 strategy: attracting more investors and partners, expanding its global presence, boosting national economic growth, and advancing Saudi Vision 2030.

items.title: Northern Trail forms tourism artery connecting 16 historical, natural destinations over 1,200 km
items.title_zh: 北方古道是一条旅游大动脉，连接着16个历史和自然景点，全长超过1200公里
items.summary: RIYADH — The development of the Kingdom's road network, which extends for more than 73,000 kilometers, has contributed to the Kingdom ranking first globally in the Road Network Connectivity Index, according to reports by the World Competitiveness Forum. This has enhanced connectivity between cities and governorates and facilitated travel across the Kingdom's regions. The Roads General Authority noted that the Northern Trail represents a valuable addition to the Kingdom's tourism sector as a tourism product extending approximately 1,200 kilometers and connecting 16 tourist destinations across Riyadh, Qassim, and Hail regions. The trail's significance goes beyond serving as a road, offering a comprehensive experience that includes more than 130 tourism activities, such as desert adventures, mountain hiking, cultural and heritage visits, agricultural and rural experiences, local food tasting, and traditional crafts. It also includes 15 farms, while more than 335 tour guides help visitors explore historical and natural sites and discover the cultural identity of the destinations. The trail highlights the historical and civilizational heritage of the regions it passes through, extending to the archaeological sites and rock inscriptions in Jubbah, which is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.Al-Marqab Tower or Raghbah Watchtower is a historic watchtower located in Raghbah in the Riyadh region, featured along Northern Trail route. The cylindrical historical watchtower in Najd dating back to the early 13th century AH, standing around 22 meters tall in six sections. Where nature meets the charm of the past, Raghbah Watchtower tells stories of a rich heritage.

items.title: Qiwa outlines 4 conditions for transferring employees’ services
items.title_zh: Qiwa 概述了调动员工服务的 4 个条件
items.summary: RIYADH — The Qiwa platform, affiliated with the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, has clarified the regulatory requirements governing the transfer of employees’ services, outlining four key conditions that must be met to complete the process.These conditions include holding a valid residency permit (iqama), as a border number alone is insufficient; not having a valid work permit with a final exit visa issued or an expired final exit visa; and obtaining the employee’s consent to both the service transfer request and the contract authentication request. The Qiwa platform clarified that changing an employee’s job title requires the employer to submit a contract amendment request, provided that the proposed title is consistent with the employee’s profession. The employee must approve the request within 10 days. It further explained that the selection of professions is governed by the Unified Saudi Classification of Occupations, with employers required to adhere to the professions available on the list designated for Saudi employees. The profession of a resident worker is reflected in the information registered in their records with the Ministry of Interior. The platform also noted that resident workers can benefit from the Occupational Management service in accordance with its applicable regulations and conditions, while any amendment to a Saudi employee’s contract requires the employee’s consent. Qiwa confirmed that information contained in service certificates, including the duration of service and job title, is drawn from expired contracts registered on the platform. An exception applies to contracts transferred from social insurance that were not updated before their expiry, in which case social insurance records are relied upon for issuing the certificate.

items.title: Education minister highlights Saudi Arabia’s transformative journey at Harvard Forum
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部长在哈佛论坛上重点介绍了沙特阿拉伯的转型之旅
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan reviewed the main features of the transformation underway in the Kingdom’s education system during his participation in the John F. Kennedy Jr. Forum at Harvard Kennedy School’s Institute of Politics in the United States. In his speech, Al-Benyan highlighted the Saudi government’s efforts to develop educational institutions, strengthen their competitiveness, and widen international partnerships. He said Saudi Vision 2030 charted the path of transformation, making education a pillar of development and a key enabler of a more competitive economy, with human capacity building as a strategic priority to equip Saudi students to excel globally.“Educational institutions must go beyond current labor market needs to anticipate future requirements,” he said while stressing the importance of building university environments that encourage critical thinking. Al-Benyan also stressed the importance of international partnerships in developing university programs and qualifying academic leaders, describing the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Scholarship Program as a unique model of knowledge exchange that strengthens the Kingdom’s presence in the global education system. **media[2796250]** Meanwhile, Saudi Ambassador to the United States Princess Reema bint Bandar met with Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan and his accompanying delegation in Boston. The meeting took place as part of the minister’s official visit to the US, which includes a series of engagements with leaders from American universities and educational and research institutions.During the meeting, Princess Reema and Al-Benyan reviewed aspects of educational and research cooperation between Saudi Arabia and the US. They explored ways to strengthen academic and scientific partnerships with leading American educational institutions. They also discussed opportunities to expand cooperation and exchange expertise in education and research. The discussion also addressed the importance of coordination and integration between the Saudi Embassy in the US and the Ministry of Education to support joint educational initiatives and programs, facilitate engagement with American universities and institutions, and expand opportunities for cooperation in higher education and scientific research.

items.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Iranian attacks on Kuwait, Bahrain and UAE oil tanker
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯谴责伊朗对科威特、巴林和阿联酋油轮的袭击
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia strongly condemned Iranian attacks against Kuwait and Bahrain, as well as an attack on an oil tanker belonging to the UAE, calling for an immediate end to hostilities and renewed diplomatic efforts to resolve the crisis. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Wednesday, Saudi Arabia expressed its condemnation and strongest denunciation of the attacks against the two Gulf states and the UAE-owned oil tanker. The Kingdom reaffirmed its categorical rejection of Iran’s continued attacks against neighboring countries and threats to freedom of maritime navigation and commercial shipping routes. It also renewed the call for an end to all attacks and respect for international law and the principles of good neighborliness. In conclusion, Saudi Arabia stressed the importance of allowing diplomatic efforts to achieve peace and resolve the crisis through negotiations, in a manner that safeguards the security and stability of the region and its peoples.

items.title: Saudi Arabia begins enforcing 15% Saudization requirement across 12 sports professions
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯开始在12个体育职业中实施15%的沙特化要求
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD) announced that a decision requiring 15 percent Saudization of designated professions in private-sector sports centers and gyms took effect on Wednesday, November 18, 2026.  The measure, implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Sport following the end of the grace period granted to affected establishments, aims to create quality employment opportunities for Saudi men and women and increase the participation of national talent in specialized sports professions. The ministry explained that private-sector establishments employing four or more workers in the targeted professions are now required to Saudize 15 percent of positions in those professions. The decision covers 12 professions in men's and women's sports centers and gyms, including sports coaches, fitness trainers, professional football coaches, professional racket sports coaches, professional water sports coaches, personal sports trainers, professional athletics coaches, sports supervisors, professional ice sports coaches, professional equestrian coaches, professional self-defense sports coaches and professional ball sports coaches. MHRSD inspection teams have begun conducting inspections across the Kingdom to verify establishments' compliance with the required Saudization percentage and take legally prescribed measures, including penalties, against violators. The ministry urged private-sector establishments covered by the decision to comply with the Saudization requirement and review the procedural guidelines published on its official website. It also emphasized the importance of reporting violations of Saudization decisions through the ministry's application or by calling its unified number, 19911. The decision forms part of MHRSD's efforts, in cooperation with the Ministry of Sport, to expand employment opportunities for Saudi men and women and develop specialized national talent to support the future of the Kingdom's sports sector.
